arguments.command:
cd /workspace && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, copy, traceback
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import validate, InvalidRequest
src=open('/workspace/tests/test_validation.py').read()
ns={}
exec(src.split('def req(')[0], ns)
BASE=ns['BASE']
d={"cases":[copy.deepcopy(BASE) for _ in range(6)]}
try:
    validate(d); print("accepted")
except InvalidRequest:
    traceback.print_exc(limit=6)
EOF
